description: Scheduled or unscheduled trip activities. Use one activity per actual stop, reservation, meal, tour, or experience. Activity creation requires latitude and longitude so the Tripsy map is populated. Use provider_reservation_code for the provider-issued reservation, confirmation, or booking code. MCP clients displaying activity dates/times must convert UTC starts_at/ends_at values into the activity timezone. Supports common list filters. Built-in activity_type slugs for Activity objects: concert, fit, general, kids, museum, note, relax, restaurant, shopping, theater, tour, event, meeting, bar, cafe, parking, amusementPark, aquarium, atm, bakery, bank, beach, brewery, campground, evCharger, fireStation, fitnessCenter, foodMarket, gasStation, hospital, laundry, library, marina, movieTheater, nationalPark, nightlife, park, pharmacy, police, postOffice, publicTransport, restroom, school, stadium, university, winery, zoo. Activity objects may also use visible custom category slugs returned by tripsy_categories_list through activity_type. Custom category slugs are only valid on Activity objects, not lodging, transportation, expense, or trip resources. MCP clients must resolve those custom slugs to display the correct activity category name, icon, and color. Safety: Closed-world: operates within the authenticated user's Tripsy account and accessible trips.

activity_type.description: Optional activity category slug filter. Only used by activities.

transportation_type.description: Optional transportation type slug filter. Only used by transportations.

updated_since.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp for incremental list filtering.
